name: Independent data commits
scope: Private checkout ownership, setup, and branch publication. Production scoring and model calls are outside scope.

name: Shared production checkout
responsibility: Holds live data and one Git index managed by the production owner. Unmigrated clones share this directory.

name: Prepare one independent checkout
responsibility: Checks ownership and active consumers, clones committed inputs, and switches only the requesting data symlink.

name: Agent-owned experiment checkout
responsibility: Holds frozen inputs and owned results with a separate working tree, Git index, branch, and object store.

name: Private Git remote
responsibility: Stores committed snapshots and experiment branches for exchange between clones.

name: Committed data snapshot
description: The full commit SHA selects inputs from the private remote. Uncommitted live edits are absent.
fields: tree: tracked private files at that commit

name: Owned experiment files
description: Only explicitly named run directories are copied. Source and destination files must have equal SHA-256 hashes.

name: Experiment branch commit
description: The owner stages named run files, commits them, and pushes an owned branch to the same private remote.
fields: commit: private Git commit containing owned run files

label: Read source identity and selected commit
Clone committed snapshot
condition: Setup passes preflight and chooses an unused branch
retries: No automatic retry; failed preparation is preserved for inspection.

label: Set experiment role and owner; switch requesting symlink
Copy explicitly owned outputs with hash checks
retries: Conflicting or changing files stop setup before the symlink switch.

label: Owner commits and pushes an owned branch
condition: Separate explicit Git commands after setup

name: One agent owns this private checkout
Shared symlinks share staging state
impact: Different clone names provide no Git isolation when data resolves to the same repository. One commit can include another agent's staged files.

name: Isolation does not reconcile records
impact: Two independent commits can modify the same record incompatibly. Production integration still requires review.

question: How can agents save private work without sharing a Git index?
options: One shared checkout with one writer
Independent experiment clones with owned branches
choice: Independent experiment clones with owned branches
rationale: This is already implemented. Production remains under one owner, while experiment commits are independent.

name: How agents publish independent data commits
focus: What does an independent data checkout change?
description: The private remote supplies a committed snapshot to each independent checkout. Its owner preserves named outputs and pushes an owned branch. Live production remains a separate checkout. Promotion is a reviewed manual procedure outside these arrows.

name: How one clone changes its data target
focus: How are live files protected during migration?
description: The requesting agent runs setup. It checks the production source, prepares a separate clone, copies only named owned runs, and checks hashes and consumers before switching its symlink. The remote clone transfer is shown in the overview.
